\section[\texorpdfstring{\ml{അപകടസാധ്യത} (apakaṭasādhyata)}{അപകടസാധ്യത (apakaṭasādhyata)}]{\ml{അപകടസാധ്യത} (apakaṭasādhyata) — a risk}

\label{lesson:ML-C442-apakatasadhyata}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for in that case, then the Malayalam for most probably.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{അപകടസാധ്യത}}
\textbf{\ml{അപകടസാധ്യത}} — \emph{apakaṭasādhyata} — \textquotedblleft{}a risk\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ml{ആ} \ml{പാലത്തിൽ} \ml{അപകടസാധ്യത} \ml{കൂടുതലാണ്}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{ā pālattil apakaṭasādhyata kūṭutalāṇŭ.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The risk on that bridge is high.
\end{quote}

\ml{അപകടം}, danger, and \ml{സാധ്യത}, a possibility: the possibility of danger.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ml{അപകടസാധ്യത}} (\emph{apakaṭasādhyata}) is a Malayalam compound: \ml{അപകടം}, \textquotedblleft{}an accident, danger\textquotedblright{}, built from Sanskrit \emph{apa-}, \textquotedblleft{}away, ill\textquotedblright{}, with a second part whose source is uncertain, and \ml{സാധ്യത}, \textquotedblleft{}a possibility\textquotedblright{}, from Sanskrit \emph{sādhya} (Monier-Williams).
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{apakaṭasādhyata}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{apakaṭasādhyata}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ā pālattil apakaṭasādhyata kūṭutalāṇŭ.} — The risk on that bridge is high.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for in that case, then the Malayalam for most probably, then say \emph{apakaṭasādhyata} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{അപകടസാധ്യത} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A risk\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\ml{മുൻകരുതൽ} (munkarutal)}{മുൻകരുതൽ (munkarutal)}]{\ml{മുൻകരുതൽ} (munkarutal) — a precaution}

\label{lesson:ML-C442-munkarutal}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for most probably, then the Malayalam for a risk.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{മുൻകരുതൽ}}
\textbf{\ml{മുൻകരുതൽ}} — \emph{munkarutal} — \textquotedblleft{}a precaution\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ml{യാത്രയ്ക്ക്} \ml{മുൻപ്} \ml{അവർ} \ml{എല്ലാ} \ml{മുൻകരുതലുകളും} \ml{എടുത്തു}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{yātraykkŭ munpŭ avar ellā munkarutalukaḷuṁ eṭuttu.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Before the journey they took every precaution.
\end{quote}

To take precautions is \ml{മുൻകരുതൽ} \ml{എടുക്കുക}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ml{മുൻകരുതൽ}} (\emph{munkarutal}) is a native Malayalam compound: \ml{മുൻ}, \textquotedblleft{}before\textquotedblright{} (DEDR 5020), and \ml{കരുതൽ}, \textquotedblleft{}care, regard\textquotedblright{}, from \ml{കരുതുക} (DEDR 1283): care taken beforehand.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{munkarutal}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{munkarutal}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{yātraykkŭ munpŭ avar ellā munkarutalukaḷuṁ eṭuttu.} — Before the journey they took every precaution.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for most probably, then the Malayalam for a risk, then say \emph{munkarutal} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{മുൻകരുതൽ} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A precaution\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\ml{പ്രവചിക്കുക} (pravacikkuka)}{പ്രവചിക്കുക (pravacikkuka)}]{\ml{പ്രവചിക്കുക} (pravacikkuka) — to predict; to forecast}

\label{lesson:ML-C442-pravacikkuka}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for a risk, then the Malayalam for a precaution.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{പ്രവചിക്കുക}}
\textbf{\ml{പ്രവചിക്കുക}} — \emph{pravacikkuka} — \textquotedblleft{}to predict; to forecast\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ml{അവൻ} \ml{ജയിക്കുമെന്ന്} \ml{എല്ലാവരും} \ml{പ്രവചിച്ചു}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{avan jayikkumennŭ ellāvaruṁ pravaciccu.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Everyone predicted that he would win.
\end{quote}

Past: \ml{പ്രവചിച്ചു}, \emph{pravaciccu}.

What is predicted comes before \ml{എന്ന്}: … \ml{എന്ന്} \ml{പ്രവചിക്കുക}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ml{പ്രവചിക്കുക}} (\emph{pravacikkuka}) is built from Sanskrit \emph{pravacana}, \textquotedblleft{}speaking out, exposition\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 8773), with the Malayalam verb ending -\ml{ിക്കുക}: to speak out what is coming.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{pravacikkuka}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{pravacikkuka}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{avan jayikkumennŭ ellāvaruṁ pravaciccu.} — Everyone predicted that he would win.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for a risk, then the Malayalam for a precaution, then say \emph{pravacikkuka} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{പ്രവചിക്കുക} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}To predict; to forecast\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\ml{കണക്കാക്കുക} (kaṇakkākkuka)}{കണക്കാക്കുക (kaṇakkākkuka)}]{\ml{കണക്കാക്കുക} (kaṇakkākkuka) — to estimate; to reckon}

\label{lesson:ML-C442-kanakkakkuka}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for a precaution, then the Malayalam for to predict.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{കണക്കാക്കുക}}
\textbf{\ml{കണക്കാക്കുക}} — \emph{kaṇakkākkuka} — \textquotedblleft{}to estimate; to reckon\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ml{നഷ്ടം} \ml{ഒരു} \ml{ലക്ഷം} \ml{രൂപയാണെന്ന്} \ml{അവർ} \ml{കണക്കാക്കി}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{naṣṭaṁ oru lakṣaṁ rūpayāṇennŭ avar kaṇakkākki.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
They estimated the loss at one lakh rupees.
\end{quote}

Past: \ml{കണക്കാക്കി}, \emph{kaṇakkākki}.

Also to regard as: \ml{അവനെ} \ml{ഒരു} \ml{സുഹൃത്തായി} \ml{കണക്കാക്കുന്നു}, I count him a friend.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ml{കണക്കാക്കുക}} (\emph{kaṇakkākkuka}) is a Malayalam compound: \ml{കണക്ക്}, \textquotedblleft{}an account, a sum\textquotedblright{}, whose origin is uncertain, and \ml{ആക്കുക}, \textquotedblleft{}to make\textquotedblright{}, native Dravidian (DEDR 333): to make a reckoning.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{kaṇakkākkuka}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{kaṇakkākkuka}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{naṣṭaṁ oru lakṣaṁ rūpayāṇennŭ avar kaṇakkākki.} — They estimated the loss at one lakh rupees.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for a precaution, then the Malayalam for to predict, then say \emph{kaṇakkākkuka} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{കണക്കാക്കുക} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}To estimate; to reckon\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\ml{അനന്തരഫലം} (anantaraphalaṁ)}{അനന്തരഫലം (anantaraphalaṁ)}]{\ml{അനന്തരഫലം} (anantaraphalaṁ) — a consequence}

\label{lesson:ML-C442-anantaraphalam}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for to predict, then the Malayalam for to estimate.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{അനന്തരഫലം}}
\textbf{\ml{അനന്തരഫലം}} — \emph{anantaraphalaṁ} — \textquotedblleft{}a consequence\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ml{ആ} \ml{തീരുമാനത്തിന്റെ} \ml{അനന്തരഫലം} \ml{വളരെ} \ml{മോശമായിരുന്നു}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{ā tīrumānattinṟe anantaraphalaṁ vaḷare mōśamāyirunnu.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The consequence of that decision was very bad.
\end{quote}

\ml{ഫലം}, a result, with \ml{അനന്തര}-, following.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ml{അനന്തരഫലം}} (\emph{anantaraphalaṁ}) is built from Sanskrit \emph{anantara}, \textquotedblleft{}with no interval, immediately after\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 287), and \emph{phala}, \textquotedblleft{}fruit\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 9051): the fruit that follows.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{anantaraphalaṁ}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{anantaraphalaṁ}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ā tīrumānattinṟe anantaraphalaṁ vaḷare mōśamāyirunnu.} — The consequence of that decision was very bad.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for to predict, then the Malayalam for to estimate, then say \emph{anantaraphalaṁ} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{അനന്തരഫലം} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A consequence\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
